name: nsauditor-ai-mcp
stderr:
nsauditor-ai-mcp: this npm package is a name reservation by Nsasoft US LLC.
It is NOT the NSAuditor AI MCP server, and it did not start one.

The MCP server ships as the `nsauditor-ai-mcp` bin inside the `nsauditor-ai` package:

  npm install -g nsauditor-ai
  nsauditor-ai mcp install-key

Claude Desktop: paste the mcpServers block that `nsauditor-ai mcp install-key` prints.
  It names node and the server script by absolute path.
Claude Code or a shell: run the installed bin from your PATH, for example
  claude mcp add nsauditor-ai --env NSA_MCP_AUTH_KEY=<from: nsauditor-ai mcp install-key> -- nsauditor-ai-mcp

Do not start the server with `npx nsauditor-ai-mcp` or `npx -y nsauditor-ai-mcp`: when the real bin is not
installed, npx fetches this package instead.
If you installed this package globally, remove it: npm uninstall -g nsauditor-ai-mcp

Docs: https://www.nsauditor.com/ai/
